preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n and v != u for v, u in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < 1000000007 for x in output)
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output must be non-negative and less than 1000000007.
The sum of the output integers must equal n^(n-2), which is the total number of labeled trees with n vertices.
